description.zh: ECS实例ID列表。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The list of ECS instance IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
The name of the ECS instance.
The page number of the returned results. Maximum value: 500.

description.zh: 每页包含的结果数。默认值10，最大值500。
description.en: The number of results per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 500.

description.zh:
ECS实例标签，必须包含：

- tagKey：标签键
- tagValue：标签值
description.en:
Instance tags of the ECS instance. The following fields must be included:

- tagKey: instance tag key.
- tagValue: instance tag value.
The ID of the VPC where the ECS instance resides.

title.zh: 获取 ECS 实例列表

descriptions.zh:
><notice> 接口前置需要创建AliyunElasticsearchAccessingOOSRole和AliyunOOSAccessingECS4ESRole的系统服务角色，用于Elasticsearch服务账号获取主账号的ECS访问权限等，详细信息请参见[采集ECS服务日志](~~146446~~)。
></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice> Before calling this operation, create the AliyunElasticsearchAccessingOOSRole and AliyunOOSAccessingECS4ESRole service-linked roles. These roles allow the Elasticsearch service account to obtain ECS access permissions of the Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see [Collect ECS service logs](~~146446~~).
></notice>.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch list-ecs-instances --page 1 --size 10 --ecs-instance-ids i-bp13y63575oypr9d0000_,_i-bp1gyhphjaj73jsr0000 --ecs-instance-name test --tags tagKey_:_a_,_tagValue_:_b --vpc-id vpc-bp16k1dvzxtmagcva0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
